description: This is a test script for the litellm project that verifies the presence and proper flow of the shared_session parameter through various functions and classes related to embedding and HTTP handling in the litellm library. It includes regression tests to ensure that shared_session is correctly included in parameters and propagates through the call chain to prevent JSON serialization errors.

classes.name: OpenAIChatCompletion
classes.description: A class representing the OpenAI chat completion interface, particularly used in embedding and completion tasks within the litellm library.

classes.name: AsyncHTTPHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling asynchronous HTTP requests, including creating clients and transports, with a particular focus on supporting shared session propagation.

methods.name: test_shared_session_in_all_litellm_params()
methods.description: Tests that 'shared_session' is included in the all_litellm_params dictionary to prevent serialization errors.

methods.name: test_openai_embedding_passes_shared_session()
methods.description: Verifies that 'shared_session' propagates correctly through the call chain involving embedding functions and HTTP transport creation.
